name.description: Template identifier: the JSON filename (without extension), prefixed with the parent directory name for nested templates (e.g. `ui/chat.json` -> `ui-chat`).

label.description: Human-readable display name. Falls back to `name` when omitted.

image.description: Icon for the template, as a URL or data URI.

deprecated.description: Deprecated templates are hidden from listings but remain installable.

defaultDir.description: Default directory name for the created project.

url.description: Documentation or homepage for the template.

tar.description: Tarball URL for the template contents.

repo.description: GitHub repository in `owner/repo` form. Must match `tar`.

branch.description: Branch within `repo` containing the template. Must match `tar`.
